skill.summary: 初始化并启动 Chrome DevTools Protocol（CDP）模式，支持用 Playwright 和 browser-use Agent 远程控制真实 Chrome 浏览器。解决 Chrome 145+ App-Bound Encryption 限制，自动复制 Profile 到非默认路径以启用 CDP...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of browser-use-init.
- Provides full Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) initialization and remote control for Chrome 145+, including Playwright and browser-use Agent support.
- Automatically copies Chrome Profile to a custom directory to bypass App-Bound Encryption and non-default user-data-dir requirement, preserving login state.
- Includes scripts for starting Chrome in CDP mode, querying connection info, and troubleshooting.
- Supports both deterministic (Playwright) and AI-driven (browser-use Agent) web automation scenarios.
- Offers step-by-step instructions, usage examples, and common troubleshooting tips.
